---

```{r instalar_paquetes, eval=FALSE}
if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("BiocManager")
BiocManager::install("muscData")
```

```{r librerias}
library(Seurat)
library(muscData)
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r cargar_datos}
sce <- Kang18_8vs8()
obj <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = counts(sce), meta.data = as.data.frame(colData(sce)),
                          project = "Kang_IFNb", min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)
```

```{r preparar_metadatos}
obj$donor_id <- as.character(obj$ind)
obj$condition <- toupper(as.character(obj$stim))
obj$cell_type <- as.character(obj$cell)
obj$sample_id <- paste(obj$donor_id, obj$condition, sep = "_")
```

```{r resumen_dataset}
cat("Células del dataset:", ncol(sce), "\nCélulas tras el filtro inicial:", ncol(obj),
    "\nPacientes en total:", n_distinct(obj$donor_id), "\n")
obj[[]] %>% distinct(donor_id, condition) %>% count(condition, name = "pacientes")
```
